    S25 Ultra - Intro

  1. Personalized briefings


    Get personalized briefings throughout the day from the all-new Now Brief. Start your morning with a run-down of the day ahead. Then recap on the day's events in the evening with daily activity insights.

  2. Circle it, find it. Hear it, find it


    Circle to Search with Google allows you to instantly search anything on your screen. Just circle an object-including images, videos or text-with your finger or the S Pen, and you'll get results immediately. You can even search for a song that you hear in the moment without switching apps.

  3. A sound studio at your fingertips


    Filter out unwanted background noise from your videos and make them share-worthy with Audio Eraser. Galaxy Al fine-tunes your audio by adjusting different types of sound including voices, music, wind and more.

  4. Personal data stays personal


    The Personal Data Engine combines and processes your primary data and provides tailored suggestions. It encrypts this data and saves it on your device with Knox Vault, making it inaccessible to anyone else.

  5. Now Bar, Widget and Notification


    Get Now Briefs at a glance from the all-new Now Bar. Directly access Now Brief and more from the new Now Bar.

    Personalize with the new layouts and redesigned widgets.

    Monitor what's in action with Live notifications.

  1. The most advanced Al ProVisual Engine


    Our next-gen ProVisual Engine is now boosted by our powerful processor-allowing you to capture, view and edit for our best camera and editing experience yet.

  2. Epic portraits, every single time


    Our Object-aware Engine detects light in the environment and precisely recognizes subjects. Flaunt your natural skin tones and textures exactly as your eyes see them.

  3. Unrivaled Nightography video. Less noise, more clarity


    Now you can shoot in improved 10-bit HDR for a more stunning videography experience. Our advanced AP also delivers more precise noise removal meaning you won't have to worry about grainy night footage again.

  4. The sharpest details from Wide to Tele and even Ultra Wide


    From Ultra Wide shots to our Telephoto camera, photos are clear and vivid at any angle. Our Al enhanced ProVisual Engine then improves color and details for next-level clarity.

  1. Processor


    The most powerful processor custom-made for Galaxy

  2. ProScaler


    ProScaler enhances resolution by using advanced Al-algorithm processing to deliver a viewing experience in high definition without having to adjust the display settings.

  3. Battery


    Our pioneering mDNle technology has been built into our customized AP, and with software optimization, battery usage time is enhanced so you can enjoy hours of watching videos.

  • What AI features are available?

    Galaxy S25 Ultra uses AI to get your apps working together with a single ask. It also comes with extra AI features such as Now Brief, Gemini Live and Audio Eraser. Thanks to the upgraded One UI 7, these features work seamlessly on Galaxy S25 Ultra.

  • How large is the memory and storage capacity of the Galaxy S25 Series?

    Galaxy S25 Series offers the most memory capacity at 12GB. Galaxy S25 Ultra offers a storage capacity of up to 1TB.

  • How is the camera better than Galaxy S24 Ultra?

    Galaxy S25 Ultra offers clearer night videos with Nightography . The Object aware Engine makes for life like portraits in diverse lighting conditions. And the new Ultra Wide 50 MP camera captures high resolution photos at all ranges including macro.

  • How good is Galaxy S25 Ultra's battery?

    Galaxy S25 Ultra’s battery allows for the longest video playback time out of Galaxy S24 Ultra, S23 Ultra, S22 Ultra, and S21 Ultra. The video playback time has been extended by 31 hours, which is 1 hour longer than Galaxy S24 Ultra.

  • How is my data protected on Galaxy S25 Ultra?

    Galaxy AI processes personalized data securely on your device through the Personal Data Engine. The data is then encrypted to restrict random access by other applications. In Control, choose how to process data or opt out of personalization.

    How customer reviews and ratings work

    Customer reviews, including Product Star Ratings, help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

    To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we do not use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things such as how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyses reviews to verify trustworthiness.

    Learn more about how customer reviews work on Amazon

      5 out of 5 stars
      Ultimate 2025 Flagship Premium, Powerful, and Refined
      Reviewed in India on 27 October 2026
      Size: 12GB + 256GBStyle Name: With exchange bonus or No cost EMIColour: Titanium Black
      Verified Purchase
      Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
      Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

      The Samsung Galaxy S25 Ultra is a true masterpiece of engineering. The Titanium Silverblue finish looks incredibly premium, and Samsung’s design updates—slimming the phone down to 218g with slightly rounded, ergonomic corners—make it far more comfortable to hold than previous models.

      The Standout Features:

      • Display: The 6.9-inch QHD+ Dynamic AMOLED 2X panel is stunning. Thanks to Corning Gorilla Armor glass, reflections are dramatically reduced, making the screen highly readable even under direct sunlight.

      • Performance: Powered by the Snapdragon 8 Elite for Galaxy chip and 12GB of RAM, this phone flies. Heavy multitasking, scrolling, and gaming are flawlessly smooth with zero thermal throttling.

      • Cameras: The upgraded quad-camera system (led by the massive 200MP main sensor and a 50MP 5x periscope lens) captures spectacular detail, natural colours, and excellent low-light photos.

      • Software & AI: Moving through One UI is buttery smooth. The native Galaxy AI tools—like Live Translate and Sketch-to-Image with the built-in S Pen—are genuinely practical for daily productivity.

      • Battery: The 5000mAh battery easily provides a full day of heavy usage, frequently hitting 7+ hours of Screen-On Time.

      What to Know Before Buying:

      • Box Contents: In line with recent environmental trends, the box is barebones. You only get the phone, a USB-C cable, and a SIM ejector tool.

      • Extras Needed: You will need to buy your own case, screen protector, and charging brick separately.

      • Charging: It supports up to 45W Super Fast Charging. The best part is that it uses universal standard USB-PD 3.0, so any high-quality Power Delivery charger you already own will fast-charge it perfectly.

      Verdict: If you want the absolute best display, top-tier performance, and long-term reliability (backed by Samsung's 7 years of software updates), this is worth every penny. Highly recommended!
